description: Trigger phrase accuracy test: should fire on WordPress security, vulnerability and compromise questions, not on general audits or non-WordPress security

should_trigger.phrase: are any of my plugins vulnerable
who are the administrators on this site
is there a WordPress security update for my site

should_not_trigger.phrase: what plugins do I have installed

should_not_trigger.reason: a plugin install request, not a review
a maintenance request with no security question; ask before treating it as one
